GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_CreditRating_Med: According to Zhera's calculations, the interest rate on this offer is fair.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_Npc_Dialogue: "Many greetings, Viceroy. Running low on wood again, are we? I'm sure we can arrange something..."
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_Rating_Bad: According to Zhera's calculations, the Syndicate is attempting to exploit your situation with this offer.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_Rating_Good: According to Zhera's calculations, the margin on this transaction is unusually low.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_Rating_Medium: According to Zhera's calculations, this offer strikes a fair bargain with a reasonable margin.
GameUI_BlackMarketPopup_RerollButtonTool: You can pay the Black Amber Syndicate to refresh their offers. This action has a cooldown.
GameUI_BlightOverlay_ToggleTooltip_Desc: You can use this button to prevent Blight Fighters from burning Cysts on this building. An open padlock indicates that Cysts will be burned. A closed padlock means that Blight Fighters will ignore this building.
GameUI_BlightPanel_Ignored_Tooltip_Desc: You can prevent Blight Fighters from burning Cysts on certain buildings by using the toggle in the Blightrot Overlay ({0}).
GameUI_BlightPanel_Tooltip_Desc: Industrial production affects Blightrot levels. The higher the recipe's Blightrot footprint, the faster Blightrot Cysts will grow. Once the storm starts, the cysts will try to corrupt the Ancient Hearth. To prevent that, build Blight Posts and assign Blight Fighters.
GameUI_BlightPost_LimitLocked: All Blight Posts will have the same limits.
GameUI_BuildingPanel_Priority_GlobalTool: Hold {0} to set a priority for all buildings of this type.
GameUI_BuildingPanel_PriorityPanel_Toolt: Lower priority goods will be produced only after higher priority recipes reach their limits or run out of ingredients. Goods with equal priority will be produced on an alternating basis.
GameUI_BuildingPanel_RecipesPanel_Limit_: Workers will produce goods until the limit has been reached. After that, they will try to continuously keep it at that level.
GameUI_BuildingPanel_SleepButton_Tooltip: Inactive construction sites will be ignored by builders.
An inactive production building will be ignored by haulers, and all workers will immediately leave it. Assigning new workers will automatically activate the building again.
GameUI_BuildingPanel_SpecializationToolt:
Cooperation (Comfortable)
(applies when 3 or more Foxes work in the same building)
GameUI_BuildingPanel_Storage_Good_Toolti: {0} to force delivery {0} + {1} for constant delivery
GameUI_BuildingPanel_Tabs_StorageEffects: This list shows global values. Bonuses or effects that only apply to a particular villager or building are not included.
GameUI_BuildingRemovalPopup_CystsSufix: Cysts on this building ({0}) will move to another structure.
GameUI_BuildingRemovalPopup_Description: You are trying to remove: {0}. This action will refund: {1}.
GameUI_BuildingRemovalPopup_KeySufix: (Hold {0} when removing buildings to skip this popup)
GameUI_BuildingRemovalPopup_None_Descrip: You are trying to remove: {0}. No goods will be refunded, as none were spent.
GameUI_BuildingSlot_OrdersTooltipAlert: This blueprint is a reward in one of your orders.
GameUI_BuildingsPickScreen_BonusPoints_T: Reserve Embarkation Points are earned by completing activities on the World Map. They are a separate pool of non-rechargeable points that can only be used during this cycle.
GameUI_BuildingsPickScreen_Tooltip_Desc: Before each game, you can use your Embarkation Points to bring extra goods, blueprints, or perks with your caravan.
GameUI_BuildingStatsPanel_Tooltip_Desc: These stats can change depending on the recipe the worker is using, or the effects that apply to a particular villager.
GameUI_BuildingStoragePanel_Tooltip_Desc: Each resource in a building has its own storage limit. When a resource reaches its limit, it will be moved to a warehouse. You can also select a resource and force it to be delivered immediately, or enable automatic delivery after each unit is produced.
GameUI_CampPanel_DontOpenGladesToggle_To: Hold {0} to change this setting in all Woodcutters' Camps.
GameUI_CampPanel_ShareButton_TooltipDesc: Propagate this mode across all Woodcutters' Camps.
GameUI_CapitalSupportPopup_Game_Descript: Some of your previously bought Citadel upgrades are no longer supported. Here are the resources you spent on them:
GameUI_CapitalSupportPopup_Game_Header: Your Citadel save is no longer supported
GameUI_ConstructionPanel_Tooltip_Desc: Construction priority can range from -5 to +5. Buildings with a higher priority value will be built first.
GameUI_ConsumptionPopup_SecondaryToggleT: This species will eat this type of food only as a last resort. You can forbid it, but this will starve them.
GameUI_ConsumptionPopupButton_LockedInMe: Unlock consumption control by buying the Obsidian Archive Level 2 upgrade in the Smoldering City.
GameUI_CornerstonesPopup_EtherealTooltip: This cornerstone option will disappear if you decide to unpause the game before choosing it.
GameUI_CursedTreasure_Desc: The Treasure Stag has been captured, and you claim its treasure - but the mythical forest spirit curses your greedy soul.
GameUI_CystSlotTooltip_Descc: Each cyst will increase the Ancient Hearth's corruption during the storm.
GameUI_DangerIcon_Tooltip_Desc: This glade contains a threat, but it also gives plenty of rewards in return.
GameUI_DemoLanding_Desc:
Your progress from the demo was successfully loaded! You can now continue playing with the new content or replay the tutorial (you won't lose your progress).

You can also reset or create a new profile in the upper right corner of the main menu.
GameUI_DemoLanding_Header: Thank you for playing the demo!
GameUI_DemoReturnPopup_Description: You launched the demo after playing the full version of Against the Storm. Returning to the demo version is not supported and could corrupt your saves. Use the quit button if you started it by mistake.
GameUI_DemoThankYou_Desc: Discover all the new features available in the full version of Against the Storm.
GameUI_DepositPanel_Priority_GlobalToolt: Hold {0} to set a priority for all gathering nodes of this type. The priority set in camps takes precedence over the priority set for gathering nodes.
GameUI_DLCLandingPopup_Bats_Decs: You have gained a new ally - the Bats - a stern and fiercely devoted people, renowned for their exceptional metallurgical skills and indomitable resilience. You’ve also discovered strange new lands - the Rocky Ravine and the Bamboo Flats. (The new biomes will appear on the world map after the current cycle ends. To unlock Bats as a playable species, you must reach level 11)
GameUI_DLCLandingPopup_Frogs_Decs: You have gained a new ally - the Frogs - a dignified and proud people known for their exceptional architectural skills and their love of water. You’ve also discovered strange new lands - the Coastal Grove and the Ashen Thicket. (The new biomes will appear on the world map after the current cycle ends. To unlock Frogs as a playable species, you must reach level 9)
GameUI_DLCLandingPopup_Frogs_Header: Keepers of the Stone DLC is now active!
GameUI_ErrorPopup_Description: We were unable to load your settlement. An automatic report has been sent. Press the New Settlement button to resume playing where you left off before the error occurred, or return to the Main Menu. If the problem persists, please verify the integrity of your local files or contact us on <style="link"><link="discord">Discord</link></style> or via <style="link"><link="helpdesk">our helpdesk</link></style>.
GameUI_ErrorPopup_ValidationRequired_Des: Some game files have become corrupted during installation, or due to a recent update. Please follow <style="link"><link="validation">these instructions</link></style> and verify the integrity of your game files. If this problem persists, please contact us through <style="link"><link="discord">Discord</link></style> or <style="link"><link="helpdesk">our helpdesk</link></style>.
GameUI_EtherealDecisionPopup_Desc: One of your cornerstone picks is ephemeral, and will disappear if you unpause the game. Do you want to unpause anyway?
GameUI_EtherealDecisionPopup_Order_Desc: One of your order picks is ephemeral, and will disappear if you unpause the game. Do you want to unpause anyway?
GameUI_FarFromHearthIconTooltip_Desc: This building needs to be within the range of an active Hearth.
GameUI_FarmPanel_PlowedFieldsTooltip_Des: During the storm, the rainfall is so heavy that the soil absorbs some of its qualities. Farmers can plow farm fields to ensure a {0} chance of growing extra crops next year.
GameUI_FeedbackPopup_ContactInfo:
Please use this form to report specific bugs or leave feedback.

Reports are anonymous, so we won't be able to reply. To talk to us directly, please message us on Discord or via contact@eremitegames.com.
GameUI_FeedbackPopup_Error: The report could not be sent. Please try again later.
GameUI_FieldTooltip_Header_Description: Farm fields can be built on this land. To grow crops, a Farm or Plantation is required nearby.
GameUI_FishingHutPanel_BaitPanel_Dropdow: There are 3 options for bait fishing. "None" - fishermen will never use bait, "Optional" - fishermen will use bait when available, "Only With Bait" - fishermen will not fish when no bait is available.
GameUI_FishingHutPanel_BaitPanel_Tooltip: You can use Packs of Crops as ground bait to double the yield from fishing. Fishermen take one piece of bait per production cycle.
GameUI_FishingHutPanel_PriorityPanel_Too: Lower priority resources will not be collected until higher priority fishing ponds are depleted. Resources with the same priority will be collected alternately. This priority overrides the priority set at individual fishing ponds.
GameUI_ForbiddenIcon_Tooltip_Desc: The crown sends a warning about this glade! It's very dangerous, and requires a lot of resources to explore, but will contain great amounts of treasure.
GameUI_FuelPanel_Tooltip_Desc: Each cyst takes 1 <sprite name="blight fuel"> Purging Fire to be burned. This bar shows the amount of fuel you have, and compares it to the number of Blightrot Cysts in your settlement.
GameUI_FuelRodsPanel_Tooltip_Desc: Inserting a Fuel Rod into a Rain Engine doubles its effectiveness, but also increases the speed at which Blightrot Cysts appear. Fuel Rods have limited power, which is consumed during production. Once depleted, they must be replaced.
GameUI_GameMenu_Abandon_PopupDesc: This settlement won't survive, and all villagers will take refuge in the Citadel.
GameUI_GameMenu_Abandon_PopupHeader: Do you want to abandon this town?
GameUI_GameMenu_AbandonIronman_PopupDesc: If you abandon a settlement during the Queen's Hand Trial, you will condemn yourself to death. There is no turning back.
GameUI_GameMenu_MoveOn_PopupDesc: This settlement has already proven its resilience, and you are free to start a new expedition.
GameUI_GameMenu_MoveOn_PopupHeader: Do you want to leave this town?
GameUI_GameMenu_RemoveProfile_PopupHeade: Do you want to remove this profile: {0}?
GameUI_GameMenu_ReplayTutorial_PopupDesc: None of your progress will be lost, but you won't have access to some of your upgrades and buildings during the tutorial.
GameUI_GameMenu_ReplayTutorial_PopupHead: Do you want to replay the tutorial?
GameUI_GameMenu_ResetProgress_PopupDesc: This can't be undone! ALL data from this profile ({0}) will be cleared and you will start afresh!
GameUI_GameMenu_ResetProgress_PopupDesc_: This can't be undone! Your world will be generated with a new seed.
This can't be undone! Because you only won {0} runs, the world map will not be generated with a different seed.
GameUI_GameMenu_ResetProgress_PopupHeade: Do you want to reset your progress?
GameUI_GameResult_Lost_Description: The Queen is not satisfied with your efforts here. You were summoned back to the court, and have lost the right to this land.
GameUI_GameResult_Lost_Seal_Description: It's too late... The Sealed Ones have taken control of this land once again, and the coming Blightstorm will only strengthen their influence.
GameUI_GameResult_Won_ContinuePopup_Desc: You won't be able to complete additional deeds, and you will not earn any more experience points or Citadel Resources.
GameUI_GameResult_Won_Description: The village's position has been secured. You can now choose to leave, or continue to play on this map - but any additional deeds won't be completed, and you will not earn any more experience points or Citadel Resources.
GameUI_GameResult_Won_Seal_Description: It's done... The Sealed Ones are imprisoned once again! Thank you, Viceroy. You not only saved our world, but also rekindled the flame of hope in our people - the faith in something that until now was only a legend of old.
GameUI_GameResult_Won_Tutorial_Descripti: This village has been secured. But there is one more test of your skills.
GameUI_GameResult_Won_Tutorial2_Descript: You proved your worth by securing this settlement! Your training is hereby complete.
GameUI_GathererHutPanel_PriorityPanel_To: Lower priority resources will not be collected until higher priority gathering nodes are depleted. Resources with the same priority will be collected alternately. This priority overrides the priority set at individual gathering nodes.
GameUI_GladeIcon_RewardChase_Tooltip_Des: The Treasure Stag is hiding in this glade. After the timer expires, the stag will run away, and the chance to receive its treasure will be gone.
GameUI_GoodsHUD_Sacrifice_TooltipDesc: You are sacrificing fuel in the Hearth.
GameUI_GoodsMenu_StorageLimitTooltip_Des: This resource has a minimum reserve set in the Main Warehouse. Workers will only use it if the amount exceeds the minimum reserve.
GameUI_GratitudeGift_Desc: The Treasure Stag vanishes into the mists, leaving you with a gift as gratitude for your empathy.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Blight_Tooltip_Desc: If there are Blightrot Cysts on buildings in the settlement, they will wake up during the storm and corrupt the Ancient Hearth. Upgrade your Hearths to reinforce the Main Hearth, and build Blight Posts to send Blight Fighters to burn cysts.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Fuel_Tooltip_Desc: There always has to be at least one Hearth burning. You can choose which goods the firekeeper will use to sustain the flame.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Hub_DecorationsDesc: At least {1} {0} decorations have to be built within range of this Hearth to raise its level.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Hub_InstitutionDesc: At least {0} service building (like a Tavern or Temple) has to be built within range of this Hearth to raise its level.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Hub_Next_LastReachedU: (more can be unlocked in the Smoldering City)
GameUI_HearthPanel_Hub_PopulationDesc: At least {0} villagers have to be housed within range of this Hearth to raise its level.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Hubs_Tooltip_Desc: Hearths can be upgraded by building homes, decorations, and service buildings within their range. Each level will grant you bonuses to Resolve, production speed, and production output. These bonuses stack with each Hearth in your settlement.
GameUI_HearthPanel_NoEffectsHeader: Nothing can be sacrificed in this Hearth.
GameUI_HearthPanel_Sacrifice_Tooltip_Des: During especially hard times, you can sacrifice additional goods in the Hearth to temporarily gain positive effects. Each fuel type grants different boons, like increasing your production speed, decreasing Hostility, etc.
GameUI_HearthPanel_StopAfterStorm_Toolti: Mark this checkbox to automatically stop sacrificing as soon as the Storm ends. You can set a default value in the Options menu under the Gameplay tab.
GameUI_HearthServicesPanel_Desc: You can expand the Main Hearth with the Commons - a shared space where villagers can fulfill service needs like Leisure, Luxury, Religion, etc. Satisfying needs here grants a smaller Resolve bonus than in dedicated service buildings.
GameUI_HousePanel_ResidentTooltip_Defaul: Select a slot to lock it. It will prevent a villager from moving into this house.
GameUI_HousePanel_ResidentTooltip_Locked: Select a slot to unlock it. It will allow a villager to move into this house.
GameUI_Houses_Upgrades_Tooltip_Desc: Species-specific houses can be upgraded using packs of goods. Each house has four upgrades in total (two for each row), but you can only choose one upgrade per row.
GameUI_HUD_Harvest_Cancel: Clear marked trees{2}. Hold {0} for a smaller marker. Hold {1} to mark trees instead.
GameUI_HUD_Harvest_Default: Mark trees for harvesting{3}. Useful when trying to carve a path to nearby glades. Hold {0} for a smaller marker. Hold {1} to exclude trees on the edge of glades. Hold {2} to clear marked trees instead.
GameUI_HUD_Harvest_NoCamps: Build a Woodcutters' Camp to cut down trees
GameUI_HUD_Harvest_NoForagers: Assign woodcutters in the Woodcutters' Camp to harvest trees
GameUI_IdleBuildingIconTooltip_Desc: No one in this building is working. Unassign idle workers or change recipes.
GameUI_IdleRelicIconTooltip_Desc: A newly discovered Glade Event is waiting for your action.
GameUI_IdleRuinIconTooltip_Desc: A building destroyed by the elements. Assign workers to rebuild it.
GameUI_LakePanel_Fishing_Tooltip_Desc: Fishermen are not gatherers, and collect resources differently. They first catch fish and algae in nets, and then transport them directly to a warehouse when the entire fishing pond is depleted. Resources held in nets are not available for use in production or consumption; they must first be transported to a warehouse.
GameUI_LakePanel_Nets_Tooltip_Desc: Resources from fishing ponds are first collected in a net and are only transported to a warehouse when the entire pond is depleted. You can choose to collect the nets earlier, but the fishing pond will automatically be depleted.
GameUI_LakePanel_Priority_GlobalTooltip: Hold {0} to set a priority for all fishing ponds of this type.
GameUI_LakePanel_RetriveButton_Confirmat: Are you sure you want to retrieve the net early? You will receive the resources it has collected, but the fishing pond will be depleted.
GameUI_LowerHUD_Texts_CancelHarvesting: {0} and hold to clear the marked trees.

GameUI_LowerHUD_Texts_Destroy_Default: Select a building or gathering node to destroy
GameUI_LowerHUD_Texts_Harvesting: {0} and hold to mark trees for harvesting
GameUI_MainStoragePanel_Abilities_Toolti: Abilities are special effects that can be manually activated in the Main Warehouse and have a limited number of uses. You can acquire new abilities by solving world events on the world map.
GameUI_MainStoragePanel_LockTooltip_Desc: If you set a minimum reserve for a resource, production buildings will only use it if the amount exceeds the set limit. This only applies to recipe ingredients. A closed padlock indicates that the limit is active.
GameUI_MainStoragePanel_Tooltip_Desc: In this panel you can select goods you want to track in a special resource category on the HUD, and set a minimum reserve limit for resources kept in the warehouse. If an item has a minimum reserve limit, production buildings will only use it if its quantity exceeds the limit. Actions like villagers eating, scouts solving events, or you completing orders do not respect this limit.
GameUI_NewcomersPopup_Dialogue: "These people have been sent here by the Crown. Which group do you want to stay, Viceroy? The other will continue on to the next settlement."
GameUI_NewcomersPopupButton_Tooltip_Desc: Next group of newcomers in {0} min.
Newcomers are waiting. The next group won't be sent until you accept this one.

GameUI_NoGoodsIconTooltip_Relic_Desc: Missing one or more materials required to complete the event.

GameUI_NoWorkersIconTooltip_Desc: No workers are assigned to this building.
